title: Activity of Scorpion Venom-Derived Antifungal Peptides against Planktonic Cells of Candida spp. and Cryptococcus neoformans and Candida albicans Biofilms.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 reconciled all linked database rows against Table 1 identity, Table 3 MICs, biofilm/hemolysis/toxicity figures, supplement text, and merged database rows. Source-supported rows are source_verified; graph-only or external/database-only exact claims remain explicit source_conflict/sequence_modified_not_normalized cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity now includes the full primary Table 3 MIC matrix, source-supported biofilm thresholds, and qualitative toxicity/selectivity evidence. Exact graph point values were not fabricated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism ontology is limited to phenotype, biofilm phenotype, indirect structure/membrane context, and toxicity/selectivity context; no direct molecular target is overclaimed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_4_publication_grade: No blocking owner-layer rework remains after worker-4/6 source review; remaining gaps are nonblocking source-scope cautions.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Some linked database rows include graph-derived exact hemolysis/MBEC values or external activity annotations not exactly recoverable from local text; they are retained as source_conflict rather than smoothed.
Primary Table 1 explicitly reports C-terminal amidation for several peptides; database rows that omit the modification are labeled sequence_modified_not_normalized.
The paper supports phenotypic antifungal/biofilm activity and structural membrane-context data, but not a direct fungal molecular target.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Hemolysis, cytotoxicity, and biofilm figures are present locally, but exact per-point graph values are not text/table data. The review preserves qualitative claims and text-supported thresholds instead of inventing numeric point estimates.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Exact database-derived graph percentages remain source_conflict cautions; Table 1 identity, Table 3 MICs, biofilm thresholds, and mechanism classes are still controllable from local material.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The landing-*.bin files are HTML landing pages rather than structured supplementary tables. The true local supplement is Presentation_1.PDF and its text was parsed.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: No additional peptide activity/toxicity table was recoverable beyond the parsed supplement PDF control SMIC50 and microscopy notes.

adjudication_summary: Worker-4/6 re-review reopened the local primary XML/PDF, OA package, parsed supplement PDF, figure assets, locator index, and linked database rows. The prior framework-only ticket is closed with source conflicts preserved as cautions, not blocking rework.
